_comment: Perk adapter: Venomancy 1.5 (poison spells with two Custom Skills trees). Its perks ask
EPMagic_SpellHasKeyword _VENOM_MagicDamagePoison (18 conditions); Venomancy.esp puts it on its own
poison effects and its optional patches on Natura's, Lost Grimoire's and Mysticism's.
_VENOM_MagicSummonVirulent marks 'Blight' summons (Virulent Binding): Venomancy's own poison skeletons,
leeches and grummites, and in its patches every spriggan summon, the Seeker and the Lurker. The lines
follow those picks: a summon with a poison or disease tag, a spriggan by race (not undead or daedra), and a Hermaeus Mora
daedra by race (seeker, lurker) with the daedra and eldritch tags.
Not given: the status keywords on Venomancy's own effects.

adapters.why: spriggans - the Natura patch marks every spriggan summon. The race keyword goes by skeleton, so undead and daedra on it (shades, golems) stay out
Hermaeus Mora's seekers and lurkers - the Mysticism and Lost Grimoire patches mark them
